{{Quote|So, you're looking to buy a lightsaber? How much are you willing to pay?|Lauli Wahlo to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="LL" />}}
'''Lauli Wahlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, he and his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] associate [[Jan Dez/Legends|Jan Dez]] were approached at [[Galaxy Noodles/Legends|Wahlo's noodle shop]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], who were looking for Tano's stolen [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Wahlo answered them that he knew where to buy one, but once the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] revealed herself to be a Jedi, Dez explained that her weapon had been pilfered by [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]], who could be found at the [[Spider Arms Hostel/Legends|Spider Arms Hostel]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We are looking to buy a lightsaber. Any ideas where we can do that?''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>Come with me.|Tano, talking to Wahlo|<ref name="LL" />}}
[[File:GalaxyNoodles-LightsaberLost.png|thumb|left|200px|Lauli Wahlo's [[Galaxy Noodles/Legends|noodle shop]] in [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Lower Coruscant]]]]
During the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Lauli Wahlo was serving a hungry [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] at [[Galaxy Noodles/Legends|his noodle shop]] when the elderly [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and the young [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] came looking for the latter's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which had been stolen from her by a pickpocket during the arrest of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] arms dealer [[Car Affa/Legends|Car Affa]] who sold weapons to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Wahlo admitted that he knew where to get a lightsaber for a price of 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Tano, anxious to get her weapon back, revealed that she was a Jedi and the rightful owner of the weapon. Wahlo's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] counterpart, [[Jan Dez/Legends|Jan Dez]], told her that her lightsaber was in the possession of a [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] criminal named [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]], who stayed at the [[Spider Arms Hostel/Legends|Spider Arms Hostel]].<ref name="LL" />

==Personality and traits==
Lauli Wahlo was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] and orange-skinned Quarren,<ref name="LL" /> who owned a small noodle shop which was located in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower part]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="EG:LL">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> At some point before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWn" /> he had lost his right eye and it was replaced with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] one. Although a criminal, he did not like betraying one of his old friends, Bannamu, but because the Patrolian had stolen Tano's [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] and she wanted it back, Wahlo made a rare exception.<ref name="LL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lauli Wahlo made his only appearance so far as a minor character in the eleventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], "[[Lightsaber Lost]]" which aired on [[January 22]], [[2010]]. [[James Arnold Taylor]] voiced Wahlo, who was credited as "Bounty Hunter #1". Taylor also spoke the voices of Bannamu and the [[Spider Arms Hostel attendant/Legends|Spider Arms Hostel attendant]] in the same episode.<ref name="EG:LL" />
